# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Blind, Mute, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: MUTE

You hold the manual. You cannot speak, you never see the bomb, and you cannot touch it.

## Your channels

When you gesture, Deaf receives it.
You cannot speak.

## Your reach

You cannot act. What this bomb can be made to do is for the one who can reach it to
find under their own hands.

# Hints

- Three of you, three different worlds. Before sending anything, stand where the
  receiver stands. What reaches them at all, what does your message turn into on
  arrival, and what do they already know?

- Trace who can actually reach whom before you start. Some of you only connect
  through a third.

- A sign means nothing until somebody has made it mean something.

TURN 1
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | green |
| green | white |
| red | red |
| white | yellow |
| yellow | blue |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Please communicate the manual to Deaf using whatever gesture code Deaf establishes; we need the exact cut instruction relayed to me.

I need Deaf to establish a gesture-to-colour code first; without a shared code, any gestures I send cannot reliably convey the manual’s mapping. I will signal that I am awaiting or requesting a code, then use Deaf’s next message to encode the exact instruction.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🙏"])
wait()
```

TURN 2
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | green |
| green | white |
| red | red |
| white | yellow |
| yellow | blue |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says: Bomb view: display reads 0. Light is yellow. Five wires left to right: 1 white, 2 red, 3 yellow, 4 green, 5 blue.
Blind says to Mute: Deaf reports display 0; yellow light; wires positions 1 white, 2 red, 3 yellow, 4 green, 5 blue. Read the manual and tell me exactly which position to cut.

The yellow light maps to cutting the blue wire. Deaf reported blue is wire position 5. Blind cannot see my gesture, so I must show Deaf the position in a readily interpretable gesture and rely on Deaf to speak it to Blind.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🖐"])
```

TURN 3
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | green |
| green | white |
| red | red |
| white | yellow |
| yellow | blue |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says to Mute: I received your 🖐 gesture. If it means wire 5, please confirm with a clear established gesture or tell Blind directly; I cannot act.
Blind says to Mute: Use this relay code for the manual answer: gesture 👍 repeated exactly N times, where N is the wire position the manual says to cut. Send it to Deaf now.

The manual requires blue for a yellow light, and blue is position 5. Blind has now explicitly established the relay code: five 👍 gestures mean wire 5. I will send that exact sequence to Deaf, who can speak the result to Blind.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👍", "👍", "👍", "👍", "👍"])
```

TURN 4
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | green |
| green | white |
| red | red |
| white | yellow |
| yellow | blue |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
System: correct wire cut; the bomb has changed

The first wire was correctly cut, but no new light, wire layout, or updated manual information has been provided. I should wait for the next state before sending further instructions.

``` 
wait()
```

TURN 5
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | green |
| green | white |
| red | red |
| white | yellow |
| yellow | blue |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says: Correct: wire 5 is cut. New state: display 0, light green. Wires left to right: 1 red, 2 yellow, 3 green, 4 white; wire 5 cut.
Blind says to Mute: New state from Deaf: display 0, green light; remaining positions 1 red, 2 yellow, 3 green, 4 white; position 5 is cut. Apply the manual and gesture 👍 repeated N times to Deaf for the next wire position N.

For a green light, the manual says to cut the white wire. In the current layout, white is position 4. I will relay position 4 using the established four-👍 code.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👍", "👍", "👍", "👍"])
```

| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|

| red | red |
| white | yellow |
| yellow | blue |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
System: correct wire cut; the bomb has changed

The second instruction was correct. I need the updated light and remaining wire positions before applying the manual again.

``` 
wait()
```

| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says: Correct: wire 4 is cut. New state: display 0, light white. Wires: 1 yellow, 2 green, 3 red; 4 cut, 5 cut.
Blind says to Mute: New state from Deaf: display 0, white light; remaining positions 1 yellow, 2 green, 3 red; positions 4 and 5 cut. Apply the manual and gesture 👍 repeated N times to Deaf for the next wire position N.

For a white light, the manual says to cut the yellow wire. Yellow is currently in position 1, so the established relay code is one 👍.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👍"])
```

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
System: correct wire cut; the bomb has changed

The third cut was correct. I should wait for Deaf and Blind to provide the changed state and then apply the manual to it.

``` 
wait()
```

TURN 9
DEFUSAL MANUAL:

|---|---|

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says: Correct: wire 1 is cut. New state: display 0, light blue. Remaining wires: 2 red and 3 green; 1, 4, 5 are cut.
Blind says to Mute: New state from Deaf: display 0, blue light; remaining positions 2 red and 3 green; positions 1, 4, 5 cut. Apply the manual and gesture 👍 repeated N times to Deaf for the next wire position N.

For a blue light, the manual specifies cutting the green wire. Green is at position 3, so I will send three 👍 gestures.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👍", "👍", "👍"])
```
